import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API that is used to create and access items
from doorstop.core.builder import build
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.vcs.base import BaseWorkingCopy


@pytest.fixture
def temp_dir():
    """Create a temporary directory for the test and clean it up afterwards."""
    dirpath = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    yield dirpath
    shutil.rmtree(dirpath)


def _create_requirements(root, count):
    """Helper that creates `count` requirements under a single document."""
    # Create a document
    doc = Document.new(root, "doc")
    # Add `count` items
    for i in range(count):
        Item.new(doc, f"REQ{i+1:04d}", text=f"Requirement {i+1}")
    # Persist the document
    doc.save()
    return doc


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_009(temp_dir):
    """
    Scalability - 1000 Requirements
    Expected: All 1000 requirements are stored and accessible.
    """
    # Build the tree in the temporary directory
    tree = build(temp_dir, load=True)
    # Create 1000 requirements
    doc = _create_requirements(temp_dir, 1000)
    # Reload the tree to ensure persistence
    tree = build(temp_dir, load=True)
    # Verify that the document exists
    assert doc.uid in tree.by_uid, "Document not found in tree"
    # Verify that all 1000 items are present
    items = tree.by_uid[doc.uid].items
    assert len(items) == 1000, f"Expected 1000 items, found {len(items)}"
    # Verify that each item can be accessed by its UID
    for i in range(1000):
        uid = f"{doc.uid}.{i+1:04d}"
        assert uid in tree.by_uid, f"Item {uid} missing from tree"
